newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Delco Electronics to double revenue by 2000.
newsitem.headline: Delco Electronics to double revenue by 2000.

text.p: Delco Electronics Corp, part of Hughes Electronics Corp, aims to double its revenue by year 2000 to over US$10 billion, William Spelman, vice president of Delco Electronics Corp, said on Thursday.

"The industry is growing at a 20 percent annual growth rate. We intend to maintain our lead position (of 23 percent market share). In so doing, we have to be more than two times larger" by year 2000, Spelman told a press conference.
Spelman, who is also president of Delco Electronics Asia Pacific, was in Singapore to receive Delco's Operational Headquarters Award.
Delco reported revenue of US$5.6 billion in 1995.
Hughes Electronics Corp is a unit of General Motors Corp.
